correction_to_prior_activation_review.statement: The prior descriptive activation audit remains valid because its probe/prefix used training=False and every BN was frozen. Its future affine-training advice requires refinement: stored nested training=False kwargs alone are insufficient in actual Keras3.15.1 Functional training. Force inference behavior inside each BN call (as this helper does), then verify actual updates/save-load leave moments exact.

interpretation: This utility opens only existing BN gamma/beta in addition to the already trainable convolution/head weights. It does not make the entire reader optimizer affine-only. The isolated SGD proof intentionally updated only gamma/beta to demonstrate their effect; actual train_on_batch also verifies the existing broader variable set.
limits: Tiny-model Torch CPU semantic proof only; actual full-v15 initialization and TF/TFLite parity remain separate trainer proofs.
No recognition accuracy, production readiness or benefit from affine adaptation is established.
